3321.news: Hill has been a free agent since Miami released him in February while he recovers from a dislocated knee and torn ACL. In mid-October 2026, a Miami civil jury found him liable on two battery counts involving his estranged wife, cleared him on eight other claims, and awarded $500,000 in compensatory damages but no punitive damages. Reports at the time said the NFL's conduct review was still open and that no immediate signing was expected. More recent reports say he is 'not healthy enough' to play, and Kansas City is now expected to trade for a different receiver rather than bring him back.
3321.take: Hill is 32, isn't fully healthy, and could face league discipline, so he's unlikely to help a fantasy team this season. Even if he signs, he would probably need time to get ready and could be suspended. In redraft he's a drop unless you have a spare bench spot. In dynasty he's no use to a 1-6 rebuilding team, and any return from a contender is a bonus, so sell for whatever you can get or cut him.
points: Free agent; recovering from torn ACL
